                    num_locations >= 15
                }
                value = 4
            }
        }
    }

    wants_this_parliament_issue_bias = {
        add = 5
        add = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    num_locations >= 15
                }
                value = 10
            }
        }
    }

    on_debate_passed = {
        add_country_modifier = {
            modifier = oe_parl_mod_rus_cossack_charter
            years = 10
            mode = replace
        }
        add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = 0.08 }
    }

    on_debate_failed = {
        parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
    }
}
